name: coil-snake
goal: Build a genuinely playable real-time native GUI Snake game powered by Coil. It must open as a native graphical application, move continuously on a timer without requiring Enter, accept immediate WASD and arrow-key input, support food, growth, score, wrap across all four board edges, self-collision game over, and restart. Crossing a board edge must never end the game. It must build and test successfully and include accurate launch instructions. Browsers, web views, HTML, and turn-by-turn or terminal interfaces do not satisfy this job. Choose an appropriate native implementation based on what is available in the environment.
